questions.question: The insoluble substance formed in a solution during a chemical reaction is known as___________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Precipitate__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An **insoluble substance** is created by a **chemical reaction or by the crystallization of a dissolved substance** to **form a precipitate**, both of which are solids that are formed from a solution.
 
• A solid substance that was once dissolved in a solvent like water becomes less soluble in the first scenario.
 
• **This may occur when:**
 
 
• The solution's temperature is reduced.
 
• The addition of a precipitating agent.
 
• The substance is mixed with still another, less soluble solvent.
 
 
 
• The **solution becomes supersaturated, and a precipitation reaction takes place** when the substance's solubility falls below its concentration.
 
• Any chemical reaction that results in an insoluble or **extremely poorly soluble product in the solvent** is considered a second instance.
 
• The solution soon reaches saturation once this product starts to develop, and the solid starts to precipitate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The particle size and characteristics of the solid are influenced by the rate at which precipitates occur.
 
• **Three different types of precipitates** can be recognized based on the size of the particles and the type of substance that is precipitating:
 
 
• Crystalline precipitates
 
• Cheesy precipitates
 
• Gelatinous precipitate

questions.question: Given below are some conclusions of Mendel's work on pea plants. All of them are correct except one. Select the INCORRECT conclusion.

options.text: Genes are inherited as distinct units.
Each gamete has two copies of the same gene.
Segregation of genes takes place during formation of gametes.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Each gamete has two copies of the same gene__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **genotype refers to the plant's genetic makeup**. On the other hand,** phenotype refers to a plant's outward appearan**ce.
 
• In **pairs called alleles**, the **genes are passed from parents to children**.
 
• **One of the two alleles **has a 50% probability of fusing with the allele of the gamete of the other parent during gametogenesis when the chromosomes are divided in half.
 
• **Homozygous alleles** are those that share the same allele, whereas **heterozygous alleles** are those that have distinct alleles.
 
• **Mendel's laws, often known as the rules of inheritance, **were developed as a result of the two experiments. **These laws are:**
 
 
• Law of Dominance
 
• Law of Segregation
 
• Law of Independent Assortment
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Gregor Mendel proposed the law of inheritance after seven years of research on **pea plants**.
 
• The laws of dominance, segregation, and independent assortment are among** Mendel's laws of inheritance**.
 
• According to the law of **segregation**, each person has two alleles, but only one of them is passed on to the next generation.
 
• According to the law of independent **assortment**, the inheritance of one set of genes is unrelated to the inheritance of another set of genes.

questions.question: At which position on principal axis does a concave mirror forms a highly diminished, real and inverted image of an object?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**beyond 2F**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• When an object is placed **beyond 2F (center of curvature)** of a concave mirror, the image formed is **real, inverted, and highly diminished**.
 
• The image is formed **between F and 2F** on the same side of the mirror.
 
• The farther the object from the mirror, the **smaller and closer the image moves towards the focus (F)**.
 
• If the object is placed at infinity, the image is **point-sized at the focal point**.
 
• This is a standard behavior of concave mirrors according to ray diagram principles in optics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Concave Mirror Image Characteristics:**

 
 
• **Beyond 2F**: Real, inverted, diminished (image forms between F and 2F).
 
• **At 2F**: Real, inverted, same size (image forms at 2F).
 
• **Between F and 2F**: Real, inverted, enlarged (image forms beyond 2F).
 
• **At F**: Image at infinity.
 
• **Between Pole and F**: Virtual, erect, enlarged (image forms behind the mirror).
 
 
 
• **Ray Diagram Rules:**
 
 
• Ray parallel to principal axis reflects through the focus.
 
• Ray through the center reflects back along the same path.
 
 
 
• **Mirror Formula:**
 
 
• 1/f = 1/v + 1/u, where f is focal length, v is image distance, and u is object distance.
 
• Used to calculate exact image location and characteristics.
 
 
 
• **Sign Convention:**
 
 
• All distances measured from mirror's pole.
 
• Distances in the direction of incoming light are negative (object side), and in the direction of reflected light are positive.
 
 
 
• **Use of Concave Mirrors:**
 
 
• Used in telescopes, headlights, shaving mirrors, and solar concentrators due to their ability to focus light.

questions.question: Fiscal policy is the policy of:

__
 
• **Fiscal policy **is the term used to describe how the government uses taxation and expenditure to affect the state of the economy.
 
• Fiscal policy is often used by **governments** to encourage robust, long-term growth and to lower poverty.
 
• Fiscal policy typically enters the picture when** conditions are deteriorating** swiftly enough to **call for government** **involvement**, such as during a recession or an inflationary era.
 
• **Purpose:**
 
 
• Fiscal policy aims to encourage healthy and stable economic growth while putting in place artificial safeguards against a financial meltdown.
 
 
 
• There are **two types** of fiscal policies: **expansionary and contractionary.**
 
 
• **​Expansionary: **The government's response to a **recession** by **decreasing taxes** and expanding government expenditure is known as expansionary policy, which is the more typical of the two.
 
• **Contractionary: **When there is** inflation**, contractionary policies are used. During this time, the government may** cut back on funding** for public projects, public sector employee numbers, or even wages.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The importance of fiscal policy as a tool for **policymaking** has fluctuated historically.
 
• Before 1930, a minimal government or **laissez-faire philosophy** was the norm.
 
• A good case study in fiscal policy is the **global financial crisis**, which can be traced back to the collapse of the **US mortgage market** in 2007.
 
• It depends on the fiscal space a government has available for new spending program or tax cuts, that is, its access to additional money at an **affordable cost** or its capacity to rearrange its present expenditures.

questions.question: The mean of the data 9, 3, 5, 4, 4, 5 and y is y. What is the mode of the data?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Sum of the 6 given numbers = 9 + 3 + 5 + 4 + 4 + 5 = 30.

Since the mean of 7 numbers is y, the total sum must be 7 × y.

Equation: 30 + y = 7y ⇒ 6y = 30 ⇒ y = 5.

The numbers are 9, 3, 5, 4, 4, 5, and 5.

Frequency of 5 is 3 (highest), while frequency of 4 is 2.

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given observations: 9, 3, 5, 4, 4, 5 and y.

Number of observations (n) = 7

Mean = y

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e5977e90f097d3cabe0b69999e6c64439dbeac79a2bad32bc0c5009f335eaca.png] 

Formula used: Mean = (Sum of observations) ÷ (Number of observations)

⇒ y = (9 + 3 + 5 + 4 + 4 + 5 + y) ÷ 7

⇒ 7 × y = 30 + y

⇒ 7y − y = 30

⇒ 6y = 30

⇒ y = 5

The data set is: {9, 3, 5, 4, 4, 5, 5}

Now, let's find the frequency of each number:

⇒ 3 occurs 1 time

⇒ 4 occurs 2 times

⇒ 5 occurs 3 times

⇒ 9 occurs 1 time

Since 5 occurs most frequently, the mode is 5.

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

**__Additional Information__**

Mean (Arithmetic Average)

The mean is calculated by summing all values in a data set and dividing by the count of values: Mean = Σxᵢ ÷ n.

Mode

The mode is the value that appears most frequently in a data set. A data set can be unimodal, bimodal, or multimodal.

Empirical Relationship

For a moderately skewed distribution, the relationship between measures of central tendency is: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean.

Median

The median is the middle value when the data is arranged in ascending or descending order. For odd n, it is the ((n+1)/2)th term.</p
